verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a bulk-operation capability, such as batch-editing, multi-select actions or batch API calls across many items. The plugin API's 'extensive access to objects' and the MCP server's general automation claims are developer building blocks an agent could use to construct bulk edits, not the capability itself. Component main-to-copy propagation is an adjacent component feature, not general bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
